init.title: Power assumptions and local access
init.description:
The Estimated Power and Estimated Energy sensors are modelled, not measured. Set the power each load actually draws on your spa so the Energy dashboard reflects it.

**Local access is optional.** Enter your spa's IP address to read its state directly over your local network, so changes appear without waiting on the cloud. Commands are still sent via the cloud. Give the spa a fixed address in your router first, or local access will stop working when that address changes. Leave the box empty to use the cloud only.

**Don't know the address?** Tick *Search my network for the spa* and press Submit. Home Assistant will look for it and fill the address in for you - nothing else is saved on that pass. The search cannot work if Home Assistant runs in a Docker container with bridge networking, because the broadcast it uses never leaves the container; type the address in by hand instead.

error.no_spa_found: No spa answered the search. If Home Assistant runs in a Docker container with bridge networking, the search cannot reach your network at all - enter the spa's address by hand instead. Otherwise, check the spa is powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant; many guest and mesh networks also block the kind of broadcast this uses.
